title: Findings from the operations review

points.text: Order intake grew in every region, but fulfilment capacity did not keep pace
points.detail: Backlog doubled between March and September; the Kazan warehouse ran above 95% utilisation for eleven consecutive weeks and overtime costs rose by a third
Electronics suppliers are back to pre-2022 lead times while packaging suppliers remain 40% slower, which forces safety stock that ties up working capital

points.text: Customer satisfaction fell for the first time in three years
points.detail: Late deliveries explain most of the decline; complaints about product quality are stable and below target in all segments

points.text: The new planning system is live in two of five plants
points.detail: Plants on the new system plan weekly instead of monthly and cut expediting costs by 18%; the remaining plants migrate in Q1 and Q2

points.text: Inventory accuracy improved after cycle counting was introduced
points.detail: Accuracy rose from 91% to 98.5%; write-offs fell accordingly and the year-end stocktake can be shortened by two days

points.text: Logistics costs per order are flat despite fuel price increases
points.detail: Route optimisation and higher load factors offset the fuel effect; further savings require the new regional hub

takeaway: Approve the capacity investment and the second planning wave
